value.rationale: Projective degree counts intersections with generic complementary linear families, so the extremizers identify the most and least prevalent three-root multiplicity strata. The factorial symmetry penalty makes the maximizing pattern genuinely different from equal balancing. The result is a complete infinite classification with uniqueness and exact exceptional cases, not a routine one-off calculation.
